messages.subject: Error in names(parsedParams) <- columnNames
messages.body_plain:
Dear MplusAutomation community,

I've encountered a problem with the extractModelParameters function as shown below.  (The same error is thrown when using readModels.)

all.params = extractModelParameters('output.out')
Error in names(parsedParams) <- columnNames :
  'names' attribute [8] must be the same length as the vector [0]

>From (a) reading through your code on GitHub (as best I can as a novice) and (b) using the debugger to look at the variable values in the extractParameters_1chunk function when the error is thrown, it looks like the problem is occurring when parsing output from confidence intervals.  The iterator i is set to 5, which corresponds to chunk lines 34:35 according to the convertMatches data frame.

Browse[1]> convertMatches
   startline            keyword varname operator endline

12        68 Residual.Variances    <NA>     <NA>      NA

Looking at lines 34 and 35 of the chunk being parsed, there aren't any parameters there.  The code seems to be proceeding as if it has parameters, even though paramsToParse is an empty string.  This causes parsedParams to have zero observations and later on the code tries to set the names which doesn't work and ultimately causes the error above.
